meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: 开启后，Claude 会把文档写作拆成三个阶段引导你：先收集背景信息，再逐节头脑风暴和修改，最后用一个全新的 Claude 实例测试文档，找出作者注意不到的盲点。Claude 会主动提问、生成候选要点、起草并精修每节内容。
howto.when: 当你说要写文档、提案等结构化内容，或提到 PRD 等文档类型时触发。Claude 会先介绍三阶段流程，询问你是否采用。

say.text: 我要写一份技术方案，用三阶段流程帮我起草。
say.note: Claude 会先收集背景，再带着你逐节写。

say.text: 帮我把这份 PRD 做读者测试，找出让新读者困惑的地方。
say.note: Claude 会模拟新读者提问并汇总问题。

say.text: 为这个章节头脑风暴几个可选点，再让我挑要保留哪些。
say.note: Claude 会生成编号选项，你回复取舍即可。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude guides document writing in three stages: gathers background context, brainstorms and refines each section, then tests the document with a fresh Claude instance to catch blind spots. It asks questions, generates candidate points, drafts, and surgically edits content.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions writing docs, proposals, or similar structured content, or names doc types like PRD. Claude offers the three-stage workflow and asks whether to proceed.

say_en.text: I want to write a technical proposal—walk me through the three-stage workflow.
say_en.note: Claude will gather context first, then draft section by section.

say_en.text: Run a reader test on this PRD and flag what might confuse new readers.
say_en.note: Claude simulates a fresh reader's questions and reports issues.

say_en.text: Brainstorm a few options for this section, then I'll pick what to keep.
say_en.note: Claude generates numbered options for you to curate.
